title: 第一章 火刑
content_zh:
“为什么要逮捕我？”一直站在人类，包括某些上等贵族之上的艾妮尔，做梦都没有想到过自己会有这么一天，随着情绪的无法遏制，她一掌击裂了石制的桌面，猛的站起。

    “请你注意自己的情绪，这种时候越是如此对你越是不利。”对面坐着的是她的律师，不是她请的，是法律程序上委派给她的，资历够老，但不可靠，可是话又说回来，在这种社会上，除了钱，又有什么是可靠的呢！

    “我没罪！”艾妮尔捏紧了双手，极力压下自己心中的怒气，坐了下来。

    “可是他们说你有罪，一切都是按法律程序走的，十分合法。”对面的他低头看着手中的文件，几张A4开面的白纸上密密麻麻的印着很多文字。

    “什么罪？”不论是出于好奇，还是不甘，艾妮尔很想知道，这些人类究竟给她找了些什么样的罪名。

    “屠杀罪，私藏枪支罪，还有叛国罪，这几项比较严重，其余的都是一些小罪名。”对方从文件中挑了几个看的上眼的罪名，情绪平静的抬头看着她，“看来不需要我费什么口舌了，这样的罪名不论成立哪一项，你的结局都是一样。”

    “……”艾妮尔沉默了一会，捏成拳的双手慢慢的展开，“这次又要我做什么，对付南方的叛民，还是北面的恐惧组织，或者魔王的爪牙！”

    从前每次都是这样，如果她不想做，那么他们就会想尽办法来逼她接手，方法各不相同，而那些任务往往都是很难完成的，不过这次竟然用到了逮捕，而且那么多条死刑的罪名，难道说让她直接去杀魔王？

    “我不明白小姐所指的是什么。”对方摇了摇头，他确实不知道，今天还是第一次与这位只在某些团体中出名的艾妮尔见面，对于围着这位小姐的某些潜规则，此时此地他应该没有必要再去了解了。

    “什么？”艾妮尔第二次激动的站了起来，松开的双手又握成了拳头。

    “明天是最后的审判日，请小姐做好心理准备，结果应该不会有太大的变化。”对方说着，也站了起来，只是他的站起是为了离开，离开这个监狱。

    “我要见斯多克公爵！”艾妮尔知道，如果还有希望，那么就在他的身上。

    “很对不起，小姐，斯多克公爵今天早上已经吩咐过，让我来看看你，并将你所犯罪刑的严重性，及可能的结果告诉你，现在我已经完成任务，明天再见！”说着，他转身向那个小门走去。

    “我没罪！”失去一切希望的艾妮尔突然冲着他吼道，面部因为不甘和愤怒变得扭曲。

    “也许！”律师转身，面对着她，“可能有些时候，只是需要这样一个结果，至于是什么原因，我只能说这样的原因一定存在，也许就像贵妇们需要新的谈资一样的荒谬，不过一定有它存在的必要。再见！”

    看着对方离开，厚厚的铁门重新关上，“砰”的巨响，将艾妮尔震醒。
content_en:
"Why are you arresting me?" Enel, who has always stood above human beings, including some high-ranking nobles, never dreamed that such a day would come to her. As her emotions became uncontrollable, she cracked the stone tabletop with one palm and stood up suddenly.

    "Please pay attention to your emotions. The more this happens at this time, the worse it will be for you." Sitting opposite her was her lawyer. She was not hired by her, but was assigned to her by legal procedures. He was experienced enough, but unreliable. But then again, in this kind of society, besides money, what else is reliable?

    "I'm not guilty!" Enel clenched her hands, tried her best to suppress the anger in her heart, and sat down.

    "But they said you were guilty. Everything was done according to legal procedures and it was very legal." Opposite him, he lowered his head and looked at the documents in his hand. There were a lot of words densely printed on several A4-faced white papers.

    "What crime?" Whether out of curiosity or unwillingness, Enel wanted to know what kind of charges these humans had brought against her.

    "The crime of massacre, the crime of concealing firearms, and the crime of treason are more serious. The rest are minor charges." The other party selected a few charges that caught his eye from the document and looked up at her calmly. "It seems that I don't need to waste any words. No matter which of these charges you are convicted of, your ending will be the same."

    "..." Enel was silent for a while, then slowly unfolded her fisted hands, "What do you want me to do this time? Deal with the rebels in the south, the terrorist organization in the north, or the devil's minions!"

    It had been like this every time before. If she didn't want to do it, then they would try their best to force her to take over. The methods were different, and those tasks were often difficult to complete. But this time, arrest was used, and there were so many death penalty charges. Could it be that she was asked to kill the Demon King directly?

    "I don't understand what the lady is referring to." The other party shook his head. He really didn't know that today was the first time he met Enel, who was only famous in certain groups. There was no need for him to understand some of the unspoken rules surrounding this lady at this moment.

    "What?" Enel stood up excitedly for the second time, and clenched her hands into fists again.

    "Tomorrow is the final day of judgment. Please be mentally prepared, Miss. The result should not change much." The other party said and stood up, but he stood up to leave and leave this prison.

    "I want to see Duke Stoker!" Enel knew that if there was still hope, it would be with him.

    "I'm sorry, miss. Duke Stoker has asked me to come and see you this morning and tell you the seriousness of the punishment you have committed and the possible consequences. Now I have completed the task. See you tomorrow!" With that, he turned and walked towards the small door.

    "I'm not guilty!" Enel, who had lost all hope, suddenly shouted at him, her face distorted with unwillingness and anger.

    "Maybe!" The lawyer turned around and faced her, "Maybe sometimes, we just need such a result. As for the reason, I can only say that such a reason must exist. It may be as absurd as ladies needing new conversation topics, but it must be necessary for its existence. Goodbye!"

    Watching the other party leave, the thick iron door closed again, and a loud "bang" shook Enel awake.
